title: Europe Must Stand with Canada Against Trump
gist: Philippe Legrain argues that European leaders should not keep their heads down while Donald Trump wages a trade war on Canada, because the EU — like Canada, a middle power — could be next, and its future prosperity and security will depend on solidarity with economic peers, as Canadian PM Mark Carney urged at Davos.

insights.claim: The European Union, like Canada, is a middle power whose future prosperity and security will depend on solidarity with economic peers rather than on going it alone against predatory superpowers.
insights.speaker: @plegrain
insights.so_what: Frames a coming bloc of middle powers coordinating trade and security responses to US pressure — a structural driver for EU-Canada alignment and diversification away from US dependence.
insights.quote: Like Canada, the European Union is a middle power whose future prosperity and security will depend on solidarity with economic peers.
insights.locator: Europe Must Stand with Canada Against Trump

insights.claim: At Davos, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney argued that middle powers must act together to avoid becoming victims of predatory superpowers — a speech that remains 'the talk of diplomats worldwide.'
insights.speaker: @plegrain
insights.so_what: Carney's middle-power doctrine is becoming a rallying framework for anti-coercion coalitions — a lens for anticipating coordinated trade retaliation against US tariffs.
insights.quote: Carney argued that middle powers must act together to avoid becoming victims of predatory superpowers

insights.claim: US President Donald Trump is waging another trade war with Canada, and Legrain warns European leaders that they could be next if they merely keep their heads down.
insights.speaker: @plegrain
insights.so_what: Flags contagion risk from US-Canada trade conflict to EU trade — a scenario to price into transatlantic tariff and export exposure.
insights.quote: Rather than keeping their heads down as US President Donald Trump wages another trade war with Canada, European leaders must recognize that they could be next.
insights.locator: Europe Must Stand with Canada Against Trump

insights.claim: Carney demonstrated middle-power solidarity in practice by standing with European allies when Trump threatened to invade Greenland, a Danish territory.
insights.speaker: @plegrain
insights.so_what: Concrete precedent that Trump-era territorial and trade threats are already triggering cross-bloc backing — raising the geopolitical risk premium around US-ally relations.
insights.quote: he has lived by his words, duly standing with his European allies as US President Donald Trump threatened to invade Greenland, a Danish territory
